RES70: Respite Chaise Lounge
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-respite-chaise-lounge-res70
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/respite-chaise-lounge/
Spec sheet: RES70 Respite Chaise Lounge
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Respite Molded Chaise Lounge – RES70
Current H1: Norix Respite Chaise Lounge - RES70
Subtitle: Trauma-Informed Lounge Chair with an Integrated Pillow and Gentle Recline for Behavioral Health and Crisis Care Rooms
Current subtitle: Norix RES70 Respite Chaise Lounge for Behavioral Healthcare and Crisis Care Environments
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Respite Chaise Lounge is a one-piece, cushioned lounge chair designed with trauma-informed principles for behavioral healthcare and crisis care rooms. Its gentle recline gives patients a calm, secure place to rest, and it stays comfortable during extended use. An integrated pillow with slightly curved sides supports the head and neck and gives patients a sense of privacy, while still letting staff monitor them.
The flexible PVC skin is filled with foam and fastened with tamper-resistant fasteners to a molded polyethylene base, with no internal openings, creases, or nooks. A concave surface at the base lets caregivers position their feet close to the chair, so they can help with patient transfers and reach the patient during medical treatment.
Construction: One-piece, rotationally molded 0.25” flexible polyvinyl chloride skin with a softer durometer for a comfortable sit
Fill and Base: Flexible 2-part water-based polyurethane foam, attached with tamper-resistant fasteners to a linear low-density polyethylene (LLDPE) base
Integrated Pillow: Curved sides support the head and neck and give a sense of privacy
Concave Base: Lets caregivers position their feet for safer patient transfers and easy access during treatment
Ligature Resistant: No internal openings
Rounded Edges: Smooth, rounded edges for a safe design
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Overall Size: 26”W×64.3”D×34.5”H
Seat: 15.6” seat height and 17.7” seat width, with a 21” arm height
Weight: 130 lbs
Colors: Twilight, Sage, Clay, Sienna, Dove, or Raven
Static Load Testing: Tested to 750 lbs
Performance Standards: Dynamic drop tested to twice the ANSI/BIFMA X5.4 impact force (250 lbs from 18”); tested to 184 lbs puncture resistance (ASTM D4833-07); meets or exceeds ANSI/BIFMA X5.4
Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletins 133 and 117
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Purple Power cleaner for routine cleaning; World’s Best Sensitive Surface Graffiti Remover for tougher stains; a thin layer of Black Magic Protectant every two months
Care Note: Apparel dyes, such as denim, may transfer onto lighter colors, and ballpoint ink and permanent markers can stain
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
RES70 – Respite Chaise Lounge: 26”W×64.3”D×34.5”H, 130 lbs
Bolt-Down Kit: Optional bolt-down kit (C011-060)
Factory Ballasting: Optional factory ballasting with up to 50 lbs of dry sand or gravel; must be specified when ordering, as the chair cannot be ballasted in the field
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Norix Respite Chaise Lounge suits rooms where patients need a calm, safe place to rest, and where staff need to monitor and reach them easily.
Typical applications include:
Crisis care and crisis stabilization units
Comfort rooms and calming rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Dayrooms, lounges, and waiting areas
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Seating
Norix makes seating for behavioral healthcare, correctional, and other high-use facilities, from lightweight stackable chairs for staff areas to heavy, ballastable lounge seating for patient and inmate areas.
The Norix seating range includes:
Stackable Chairs: Integra, Progress, and Affinity
Guest and Lounge Seating: Flux, Forté, Vesta, Hondo Nuevo, Ripple, Wink, and Toro
Indoor and Outdoor Seating: Coupe, Flux, Pax, Kube, Goby, and Riptide
Upholstered Seating: Forma, Element, Harmony, and Respite
Rockers and Stools: Flux, Rocksmart, Mix-Up, and B-Side
Metal Seating: VersaFrame, Boulder, and Terra
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: same "About Norix Seating" section as the C920 tab.
PRICE: the live page shows $0.00 with no compare-at price. The Norix April 2026 price list says $4,500. At your usual 80% of list, the price would be $3,600.00 (compare-at $4,500). Andrew's price note was for the Arcadian products only, so please confirm.
Options: the price list shows the bolt-down kit (C011-060) at $112 and factory ballasting at $84 (list). Both are mentioned in the text but are not variants on our page. Would you like them as variants? If yes, please give me the SKUs.
Applications: Norix calls the Respite "the ideal hospital recliner chair," but it has a fixed gentle recline, not a reclining mechanism, so I did not use "recliner." The crisis care and calming room uses come from Norix ("behavioral healthcare and crisis care environments") and the Norix room photos.
Cleaning: the Respite uses a PVC skin, so Norix gives different cleaning products from the molded furniture (Purple Power, World's Best Sensitive Surface Graffiti Remover, Black Magic Protectant). I added the dye transfer note from the spec sheet so buyers of light colors know.
Removed from the current page: "Premium TruColor technology..." The Respite spec sheet does not mention TruColor (it is a PVC skin, not molded polyethylene).
Spec sheet typo: it says "ANSI/BIFMA X5.4-205." I wrote "ANSI/BIFMA X5.4."
Weight and size match the spec sheet and the worksheet (row 186: 130 / 64.3 / 26 / 34.5). The price list has no weight for the Respite.
Images: the 3 current images are kept (Sage, Sienna, and the color chart, no alt text). Norix also has photos in Twilight, Clay, Dove, and Raven (600×600) and a calm room photo (2560×1920). Would you like me to add them as "Norix-Respite-Chaise-Lounge-RES70-Twilight.jpg," "-Clay.jpg," "-Dove.jpg," "-Raven.jpg," and "Norix-Respite-Chaise-Lounge-RES70-Calm-Room-View.jpg"?
Collections: the Respite is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, Transitional Housing, and Norix Furniture.
Removed: the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
